title: Jumpmasters OBX Fun Park
blurb: The only trampoline park on the Outer Banks! Veteran and locally owned, Jumpmasters features obstacle course lanes, a climbing wall, foam pit with foam pugil sparing sticks, trampoline dodgeball area, multiple trampolines and more. All areas are surrounded by padded floor and deck space, to ensure safety. If jumping is not your thing we have our newest attraction, OBX AXE THROWING. We introduce you to the sport of Urban Axe Throwing following the standards and procedures of the World Axe Throwing League.
